lens: Goal #805 context-reuse bounded design follow-up: customer-01 and accepted F1–F4 repairs

counterweight_triage.concern: customer-01: missing consumer and fallback inputs
counterweight_triage.disposition: The supplied registry, adapter contracts, direct consumers, and concrete fixture definitions establish implementable first actions, invalidation tripwires, and observable acceptance. Spec correctly uses contract-context states without an invented adapter. Provider contradiction, debug evidence-mode transition, cross-subject interruption, and no-write recurrence intersections are explicit.

counterweight_triage.concern: F1: automatic writes defeating chat-only selection
counterweight_triage.disposition: Explicit no-write precedence covers adapter, artifact, summary, lesson scoring/seeding, and RCA writes. Triggering selects reflection; an existing output directory does not require persistence. Unperformed durable obligations remain open, and probe state semantics are preserved.

counterweight_triage.concern: F2: mandatory lenses and planner instructions defeating direct counterfactuals
counterweight_triage.disposition: The contract requires one action-changing counterfactual, makes names and additional lenses conditional on distinct value, and explicitly requires reconciliation of references and emitted planner instructions. Current governing-standard context may be reused while parsed artifact sections remain.

counterweight_triage.concern: F3: subject matching mistaken for current investigation authority
counterweight_triage.disposition: Reuse requires the same open investigation with known target, subject, evidence mode, output contract, and validator, plus reconciliation of pointer, resolution, and repo-wide risk deltas. Invalidated cases return to the subject/evidence-preserving planner path.

counterweight_triage.concern: F4: surviving numeric or plural cause quotas
counterweight_triage.disposition: Both quota forms are explicit repair targets. A single cause retains its falsifier; competing evidence requires alternative testing. Durable diagnosis and recurrence obligations remain.

counterweight_triage.concern: Additional design ceremony or premature behavior approval
counterweight_triage.disposition: No further design round or eligibility artifact is warranted by these findings. Existing contradictory instructions are declared implementation targets. Observed consumer execution, exported-path verification, and measured benefit remain later proof obligations.

next_move: Parent may integrate this bounded design acceptance, implement the accepted repairs across the named consumers, and run the planned focused checks and first-reader scenarios. No unresolved design risk remains within customer-01 and F1–F4.
non_claims: Reviewed all 14 supplied semantic payloads and the packet as inline input; no workspace edits, supplemental inspection, execution, or delegation occurred.
